ചെയ്തുകൊണ്ട് കർത്താവിന്റെ പ്രേഷിതരാവുക.
english:
A thousand thanks to Jesus and to Mother. My name is Jobitta Joy. I am here to take the covenant. It is April 21, 2022.
That was the first time I came here to take the covenant. Back then, many people used to share testimonies. Friends also told me and I listened — that is how I came.
When I came, I had written down and submitted six intentions here. The very first time I took the covenant and went back — immediately,
at that time, when I came here to take the covenant, I had a lump in my right hand joint. It was the size of an Indian gooseberry.
There was severe pain. It was difficult for me to work. I have a small child, so carrying the child and working with one hand —
in such situations, it was extremely difficult. I had consulted a doctor. They had given me painkillers. When I came here and
took the covenant — though I had not written that lump as an intention — I truly believe that Mother knew my most urgent need and did it for me.
After I took the covenant and left, within the next few days, the pain from that lump disappeared. When the pain went away,
I was able to do all my work without any difficulty. Then, after a few more days, because there was no pain, we tend to forget it.
After one, two, or three weeks had passed, when I was talking with my mother on the phone, she mentioned that lump. Then I applied holy oil…
I was always praying with it. Then my mother asked me, “How is that lump now?” When I looked at my hand, honestly, I was truly
astonished. The lump was not there. Even now, in my hand there is no lump, not even a small swelling. That was the first blessing I received. Later, the covenant —
salt, salt — I used it by putting it into my bath water. Otherwise, even a small mosquito bite, or just when a fly touched me,
my body would itch badly like an allergy, and swellings would appear. It was when I was struggling a lot with that, that I began to use the salt.
In that way, that too was healed. After that, I renewed the covenant on October 1, 2022. After that, I received many blessings.
I had a great desire for a job. But at home, it was only me, my husband, and the baby.
So there was no way to leave the child somewhere and go.
When the baby was just one year and 9 months old, I got a job as a teacher in an aided school. At that time, Mother knew my situation and
blessed me — because near the school where I got the job, there was a daycare. There, I was able to leave the child and go to work.
Mother arranged everything — she gave me that job, and all the help I needed to be able to go to work. Along with that, at my husband’s house,
there was a problem with water. There was a well, but during the summer, it was very difficult to get water from it. After marriage, I often heard them say,
that they had dug many places for a well, and even tried drilling bore wells, but never got water. Later, at that time, my husband’s elder brother was digging a well there.
Then Mother told me, “Put this holy salt in the well.” With faith, we prayed and put that salt into the well. From that time until today, without drying up,
there is good water in that well. After that, I again renewed the covenant. After renewing, within a month,
a big incident happened in my life. My husband had a bike accident. He had a serious head injury, his skull was fractured in places.
That is how bad it was. It was on April 7, 2024, that this happened. He had gone to the shop, and on his way back, it occurred. When I called him,
I couldn’t reach him, and then another person picked up the phone and informed me. Then, the next-door neighbor took him to the hospital.
It was at Kolenchery Medical College Hospital. Then, that elder brother from the next house quickly took me and the baby to the hospital. When I left home,
I hadn’t taken anything else, but suddenly I felt like taking Mother’s oil. I carried that oil with me. When we reached,
they were taking him for a CT scan.
As they were bringing him back, they said, “Look, we are going to put him in the ICU.” Right then, I rushed, touched him with the holy oil, and prayed.
But there was no movement from him. Then they quickly put him in the ICU. For two days — the first
and second day — when I went in to see him, the only thing I saw was that his right hand
was moving slightly without reason. Other than that, there were no movements, not even in the eyes. Then suddenly, on the third day,
There, at the ICU, I was standing outside because of having the baby. Then I went inside the ICU…
In the evenings I would go to see him. Then they told me, “Today the patient has a slight fever, no one from outside is allowed in.”
At that moment, I felt a terrible heaviness in my heart. So I asked, “If there is anything, you must tell me openly.
Otherwise, I will not be able to handle it.”
Still, no one said anything. They had not even kept the CT scan report in their house — it was kept at the neighbor’s house nearby. When I realized this,
I thought to myself: I must go to Kreupasanam, I must see Father. I asked them, “Please give me that report.”
At first, they did not agree. Then I told my aunt, “Aunty, somehow please get the report for me. I must
go to Kreupasanam and do this for my husband.” I had decided firmly. Finally, they agreed to give it.
With the neighbors, they brought me here. Even then, they were holding the report in their hands, not giving it to me. When I stood in the queue here,
they stood right next to me, still holding the report. But only I was allowed to go inside. Then, when I reached inside,
they finally handed me the report. I went in. As I was folding the paper and placing it here, I saw that a photocopy of his CT scan had been taken.
That photocopy was meant to be shown to Father. That was the first time I saw it — the skull was so badly broken.
When I saw that, I truly thought at that moment, “He cannot survive. Oh God, is everyone deceiving me? What am I seeing?” Then I began to cry.
Kneeling down here, as I entered the church, I felt a terrible headache coming on.
From here, I cried a lot.
Even when I saw Father, I stood crying. I could only look at the image of Jesus on the cross. I thought —
this is exactly the condition of my husband now. I prayed to Mother: before this, my husband, my child, and I used to come here together.
“Mother, will we never again come here together? Will you not bless us for that?” I prayed. After that, I saw Father.
Father gave me blessed medals, prayed, and I brought them to Mother and prayed. When I stepped down from the church,
the terrible headache I had immediately disappeared. After I came out I called my brother to know about my husband, the reply I got was:
“No change, it is the same as the past days.” But from the tone of his voice,
I understood there was a joyful note — a good improvement. After that,
he never went backward, not even a little. Only great progress happened. Then, whenever I went into the ICU, I would
speak Scripture into his ears, recite prayers, or even play recorded prayers from the mobile so he could hear.
He opened his eyes after two weeks. He was on the ventilator for about two weeks.
After two weeks, he opened one eye.
The injury was on the left side of his head. So, the left eye had still not opened.
After that, when I came here as I said before I met the Father. Then in the evening I said to my brother, “Today, whatever happens, I must go near my husband. You must allow me.”
He said, “You may go inside, but only if you do not cry.” I agreed. Still, I was not sure that I would be able to hold back my tears.
Even then, I went. Because I had to take the covenant medal and the holy oil there. From the beginning, whenever I went inside,
I would carry the holy oil in my hand. Without the nurses noticing, I would quickly anoint the forehead with the holy oil while praying.
Not everyone would like it. Once, when a nurse saw this, she told me, “Sometimes the doctors may not like it.”
That evening, I went near him with the holy oil and the covenant medal. When the nurse saw me applying the oil, she asked me, “Sister,
is this the oil from Kreupasanam?” I said, “Yes, sister.” She said, “Keep it here itself; we will also apply it in between.”
So I placed it there. When I tried to pin the covenant medal on his dress, she said, “During cleaning and dress changing, sometimes this may be lost. So, pin it to the bed instead.”
That very nurse herself pinned it near his head on the bed. From that day onwards, they also applied the holy oil.
Whenever I went inside, I too applied the oil and prayed. That covenant medal and the oil remained with
him the whole one month he was in the ICU. After one month, he was taken out of the ICU.
During all those hospital days, this oil and the covenant medal remained with him. That was the greatest blessing Mother gave me in my life.
Whenever I returned from here, I was very sad, thinking whether there would ever be another chance to come like this.
On that very day, I prayed, “Mother, please allow me to bring him here again to give testimony.” And Mother granted it.
I could not have received a greater blessing in my life than that.
Later, at that time, I had not yet received my job order, though I had passed. It was an aided school.
But after the renewal at that time, it was renewed, and very soon after that, I was given the appointment order.
My biggest desire was to get a government job. Though I was in an aided school, I used to write PSC exams.
My wish was to receive a PSC appointment. Now that too is about to be fulfilled, because I have received advice from the PSC.
Mother has always been with me, understanding all my situations. She has given me each blessing according to each circumstance.
Sometimes we feel disappointed. We place our petitions, expecting them to be granted immediately.
But what I realized is that, for us to reach that goal, Mother arranges each step, makes the path smooth, and fulfills everything, leading us to the destination.
I distribute newsletters. When I go to town, I give them to shops, to coworkers, and to the general public.
At first, I used to feel some hesitation. Later, without hesitation, I would walk across the whole town of Kothamangalam — from one side to the other — even in the hot sun.
I would say to myself, “Let me endure this sacrifice; it is enough if Mother grants me blessings.” So I went about distributing newsletters.
To those who said they didn’t want, I would not give. Many people looked at me with contempt.
But even then, I began to feel a real joy within me. At first there was hesitation, but later, when someone mocked me because of this, I started to feel a joy.
I felt — it is for a purpose that I am doing this. After that, I received the grace to pray a lot.
Also my husband, he sits with me to pray. In the evenings he asks, "Isn't it time to pray?".
Every week he goes to church, confession — all of that he follows correctly.
Afterwards, charitable works — I work in a school, and among us there are many children with various needs.
Knowing that, I never tell anyone, but I help them quietly. Also, among those around me, if someone is in need, I help in whatever way I can.
Always, even now, when I look at my own family, I find myself in situations where I do not have enough.
But my mother taught me a lesson: even if we have nothing, we must share from that nothingness.
I saw my mother doing that from my childhood. That became a great inspiration for me, so I too do the same.
From that, I realized in my life that — when we lack something, God sends us help from unexpected places.
Even now, I have received much help from people I never expected. God has always sent help to me in my time of need.
The great lesson I learned from this covenant is — we must have goodness in us, we must not betray others, we must help others according to our ability.
From that, I understood that God will bless us abundantly. I offer endless thanks to Mother and to Jesus who gave me these great blessings.
From the book of the prophet Isaiah, chapter 53: He was wounded for our transgressions,
He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His wounds we are healed.
Beloved in Jesus, this is the testimony of Jobitta Joy from Muvattupuzha, spoken here in the presence of the Holy Mother.
She prays, “Mother, grant that the three of us may always come together into Your presence. My life partner met with a great accident — please save him from that.
Grant that we may always come together into Your presence, O Mother.”
The Mother of Mercy, who melts when she sees tears, is the one we hope for at Kreupasanam. Mother is the living Mother.
That daughter says: “I had a lump on my hand. I never told Mother. I prayed using the votive items. Mother removed it without me saying anything.”
So, do not be troubled thinking, “Ah, I didn’t place that petition, I should have placed it.”
Mother knows. She is the living Mother, the traveling Mother. Even things we did not mention — she has already worked on them.
The covenant life is not only a prayer life, but also a working life. For this great grace given to her, let us clap our hands and thank Jesus through the Blessed Mother.
